title: Bound one next-contact donor MOVE hoist on #7334
body:
**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On #7334 aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace and #7113 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d, keep one donor's paid MOVE and hoist it to the same literal chart before the owned ascent. The donor must already be live and its old MOVE must be its next contact.

The geometry exhausts 23 paid ascents. Eight sites admit 13 eligible pairs. Two exact modular probes exclude all 13 single-donor multiples. Separate rational forward and reverse checks exclude all 13 spans of a shifted donor with the unchanged destination bank. Zero cases remain in scope. The eligible sites have a rigorous upper bound of 238 weighted-rank units with zero added paid calls. Verified paid savings are zero.

Run python3.12 -I -B research/p104-one-donor-move-hoist-bound/replay.py from a clean checkout. It authenticates the word and source receipts, regenerates seven receipts, and rejects an altered-input control. Registered and exported Git-free replay and all 27 onboarding tests passed locally. The branch includes two #7257 CI prerequisites.

#7334 and #7113 supply the word and caller, #7387 the fixed-bank result and exact separating inputs, #7355 the reverse engine, #7362 the rank stock, #7298 directed pricing, and #7360 comparator replay. #7330, #7378, #7392 and #7393 give related results. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

A multi-donor itinerary or changed observer remains open. Price one exact changed cut first, then test whether it defeats the committed separator.
